newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $10 MLN CHINA GSM EXPANSION.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $10 MLN CHINA GSM EXPANSION.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Thursday it won a GSM network expansion order from China worth $10 million

"Nokia Telecommunications has been chosen to be the main base station subsystem supplier for the third phase expansion to China Unicom Shanghai branch's GSM network expansion," it said in a statement.
Nokia said it would supply base station controllers and base stations as well as provide services, including network planning and installation.
"After the third phase expansion, the network will have capacity for a total of 150,000 subscribers in Shanghai," Nokia said.
